name: ZORY AI
author: zory1

sections.description:
Understand Your Customers Better. Sell Smarter. Increase Conversions.

Transform your store into an AI-powered shopping experience that goes beyond traditional chatbots. ZORY connects intelligent conversations, product discovery, visual search, and interior design with your real product catalog, helping customers find the right products, make confident decisions, and move faster toward purchase.

Compatible Store Categories: ZORY is designed for furniture stores, home decor retailers, lighting stores, home furnishing businesses, and other retailers offering interior-related products.

Beyond assisting shoppers, ZORY helps your business understand customer preferences, identify buying intent, reduce purchase hesitation, and uncover new opportunities to increase sales.

ZORY Capabilities

  • Intelligent Conversations: Engage customers in Arabic and English through text or voice with contextual conversations.
  • AI Vision & Visual Search: Identify furniture, styles, and colors from images to find similar products.
  • Smart Product Search: Discover products by category, style, size, material, color, and budget.
  • Product Info & Comparison: Answer product questions and compare prices, specifications, ratings, and warranties.
  • Interior Design & Room Planning: Create room designs, plan layouts, and visualize store products in real spaces.
  • Personal Shopping Assistant: Build shopping lists, manage budgets, suggest alternatives, and support cart actions.
  • Upselling & Cross-Selling: Recommend complementary products, matching collections, and relevant upgrades.
  • Customer Intelligence & Smart Memory: Remember customer preferences and past interactions for personalized recommendations.
  • Business Dashboard & Analytics: Track customer interests, purchase intent, product demand, and sales opportunities.

Why ZORY?

  • Understand Your Customers: See preferences, budgets, buying intent and hesitation.
  • Improve Conversion: Build buying confidence and remove purchase barriers.
  • Recover Lost Sales: Spot hesitation early and act before carts are abandoned.
  • Increase Order Value: Suggest matching items, collections and upgrades.
  • Catalog-Grounded Answers: Every answer and recommendation comes from your real products.
  • Deliver Reliable AI Assistance: Provide consistent, catalog-grounded answers and recommendations.
  • One Connected Experience: Combine sales, shopping, interior design, and customer service in one AI solution.

What the plugin does

  • Connects your store to ZORY with WooCommerce’s own key approval screen. You approve read and write access, enter the email your ZORY login is sent to, and your products are imported.
  • Keeps ZORY up to date through WooCommerce webhooks: a product or variation saved, stock taken by an order, a product moved to the bin or restored.
  • Adds the assistant to your storefront while your ZORY plan is active, with an on/off switch under ZORY AI > Settings.
  • Shows your plan under ZORY AI > Plan: buy, add design generations or remove the “Powered by Zory” badge, pay by card (MADA, Visa, Mastercard, American Express) or Apple Pay, and cancel.
  • Reports results: product views, adds to cart, checkouts and purchases of products shoppers reached through ZORY, in your ZORY business portal.

The plugin’s screens are in English and Arabic.

ZORY AI is a service: a ZORY plan is needed for the assistant to appear on your storefront. Plans and prices are listed under ZORY AI > Plan.

External services

This plugin connects your store to ZORY (https://zory.ai), an AI shopping assistant service. Nothing is sent to ZORY until you press Connect to ZORY.

Privacy policy: https://business.zory.ai/app/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce. Your site must be served over HTTPS, and Settings > Permalinks must not be “Plain”.
  2. Install and activate ZORY AI from Plugins > Add New.
  3. Open ZORY AI > Settings and press Connect to ZORY. Approve the access WooCommerce asks for, then enter your email.
  4. Sign in to the ZORY business portal with the login emailed to you.
  5. Buy a plan under ZORY AI > Plan, then tick Show ZORY on my storefront under ZORY AI > Settings.
sections.faq:
More answers: https://zory.ai/en/ai-agent/faqs

Does it change my products or orders?

No. ZORY reads your products and store settings, and creates the webhooks it needs. It keeps on each order, in a field named zory_clicks, which of its products the shopper reached through ZORY. It never edits your products, prices or orders.

What happens if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

ZORY is told, removes your store and its products from ZORY, and stops your plan renewing (it stays active until the end of the period you paid for). Your ZORY account stays. The “ZORY AI” API key remains under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API for you to revoke.

Which payment methods can I use for my plan?

Cards (MADA, Visa, Mastercard, American Express) on the payment page inside WordPress, or Apple Pay on ZORY’s page in Safari on an Apple device. Payments are processed by HyperPay; card details never reach ZORY or WordPress.

Does the plugin add a “Powered by Zory” credit to my site?

No. The plugin adds no credit or link to your site. The assistant is drawn by ZORY’s service, which shows a small “Powered by Zory” mark inside it, as part of the service’s own output. You can have ZORY remove it under ZORY AI > Plan.

Does it work with the block checkout and HPOS?

Yes. The plugin supports WooCommerce’s block cart and checkout and High-Performance Order Storage.
